title: No One's Immortal
description: Adds a lives system to Minecraft. Players start with limited lives - run out and become a spectator! See how many Lives you have left in your HUD
body:
Bring normal Minecraft closer to Hardcore Mode with this mod.

Adds a lives' system to Minecraft. Players start with 3 limited lives and will lose one on death. Run out and you'll become a spectator! Configure via JSON file or in-game GUI (requires Cloth Config + Mod Menu).

Your current lives are displayed in your HUD. The default is in the top left, but you can configure it to be anywhere on the screen.

Includes a /setlives command for server admins.
